note: Declared inputs from outside the model. Every sensor states its authority, its least-privilege scope, and where its configuration comes from. Configuration lives in the environment; this repository holds names, never values.
rules: Least privilege: request the narrowest scope that satisfies the read, and never a broader one for convenience.
No secret, token, spreadsheet id or client credential is committed. A test enforces it.
A sensor's authority is granted in core/autonomy.json, not by the adapter that implements it.
Data arriving from a sensor is an observation with provenance and a retrieval time. It is never a verified fact by virtue of having been fetched.

sensors.label: Lane California Move Command Center spreadsheet

auth.scope_note: spreadsheets.readonly reads only spreadsheets the account can already open. Drive-wide scopes are refused: the adapter never needs to enumerate or open other files.
auth.token_location: outside the repository, in the user config directory

sensors.expected_tabs_note: Carried from the handoff document, never confirmed against the live spreadsheet. The first real read verifies or corrects this list; it is not treated as fact until then.
sensors.verification: Level 4 only. A parser test against a fixture does not verify this sensor.
